page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number left, heading line below; then running text in one column with a verb-paradigm list interspersed; a centred subheading "Futurum." followed by a second list and a paragraph start at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Idem tempus aliter declinatum.
main_text.l: Io hauerei amato vtinam ego amauissem.
main_text.p: Quod autem ad modum subiunctiuum attinet, a modo optandi nulla in re, praeter duas, discrepat: quarum vna est, quod loco aduerbiorum, ò Dio vo-glia, ò che, &c. habet aduerbia, Cocio sia cosa che, Auégna che, Quándo, & huiusmodi. Altera est, quod explicare per se habet Futurum, quod ita inflectitur.
main_text.head: Futurum.
main_text.l: Io hauero amato Quum ego amauero.

page.notes: Several Latin verb forms are partly illegible at the right edge of the list lines; the Greek-letter aduerbia "Dio vo-glia" and "Cocio sia cosa" are set with hyphenation and may be imperfect. Some lines in the paradigm are doubtful and marked only by reading.
